The team included Gen. Paul Adams, commander of the mobile strike force alerted for emergency ground action in the war. The British sent a similar mission, head by Duncan Sandys to synchronies with the United States mission's in New Delhi. They together processed India's request for military aid for the next three years, formalized few weeks later at Nassau by President Kennedy and Prime Minister Harold Macmillan. The 120 million dollar aid package gave small arms, ordnance machinery and ammunition, the donors sharing the cost." Mohon Ram, *Politics of Sino Indian Confrontation*, pp. 123-124.
